_meta.source: C6 (m1) data-source recoverability from the provenance-free FEATURE SET (the deployment set), vs raw inputs. Same held-out probe and assembly as icp_recoverability.json; reproduction gate ties the raw-feature logistic AUROC to the frozen value within 0.02.

interpretation: PF-set AUROC well above 0.5 but below the raw-feature AUROC means dropping the explicit provenance features reduces but does not eliminate source-recoverability (residual dummy_na re-encoding), so the provenance-free signal is an upper bound on the environmental signal — consistent with m1.
